description: Implementation of the AudioFrameDiscarder class methods for handling audio buffer input, adjusting for discarded durations, end-of-stream handling, and reset functionality within the starboard::shared::starboard::player::filter namespace.

classes.name: AudioFrameDiscarder
classes.description: Class responsible for discarding audio frames and adjusting decoded audio based on discard durations.

methods.name: OnInputBuffers
methods.description: Processes incoming input buffers, storing timestamp and discard info, with thread safety and validation.

methods.name: AdjustForDiscardedDurations
methods.description: Adjusts the decoded audio object based on stored discard durations, with timestamp validation.

methods.name: OnDecodedAudioEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream event, logging if there are pending input buffer infos.
